parsed.scene_description: A commercial interior scene featuring multiple glass-door refrigerated units stocked with beverages. A red advertising panel is mounted on the wall above the fridges. To the left, a metal shelving unit holds packaged goods. The lighting creates reflections on the glass surfaces of the fridges and shelves.

objects.label: refrigerated display unit
objects.observation: Large commercial fridge with glass doors, displaying rows of bottled drinks. Located centrally in the image frame.

objects.label: refrigerated display unit
objects.observation: Adjacent fridge unit to the right of the central one, also containing beverages.

objects.label: metal shelving unit
objects.observation: Shelving structure on the far left holding various packaged items. Only partially visible.

objects.label: advertising panel
objects.observation: Red rectangular sign mounted on the wall above the refrigerated units. Contains text and images.

objects.label: bottled beverages
objects.observation: Numerous bottles of various colors arranged on shelves inside the refrigerated units.
